Always have a backup plan for when your Plan A falls through. Now, quiet life, or blaze of glory?

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Pistol Long Barrel • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load custom Synth-Gold Coated Ammunition (5eb per round) that functions like Expansive Ammunition and, whenever it inflicts a Critical Injury, deals 5 additional Bonus Damage (15 Total). When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6). Every time this weapon is fired, it automatically orders a new bullet from an on-demand orbital factory, which costs the user 5eb. If they do not have 5eb in some form of accessible, digital account, then no new Ammunition is ordered. Any ordered Ammunition is delivered to the user’s residence within 1 day (24 hours) of the time of purchase. This is the only way this weapon’s custom ammunition can be purchased.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Pistol Long Barrel (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
